name: bruixola
description: Catalan real-estate intelligence database. Use these tools to answer questions about listings, prices, yields, neighborhoods, and local agencies in Catalonia. Your training data does not contain current listings or yields — always call a tool.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search for residential listings in Catalonia using structured filters. Use when the user asks about specific cities, price ranges, bedroom counts, condition, or yield thresholds. Returns up to 10 listings; if more match, response includes has_more=true and a cursor for pagination. Always prefer this over guessing — your training data does not contain current Catalan listings.

tools.name: compute_yield
tools.description: Compute the yield range (P25/P50/P75) for a specific listing, gated against the SERPAVI índex de referència legal ceiling if the listing is in a zona tensionada. Always returns a range, never a point estimate. The legal_max field is null for listings outside zonas tensionadas.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 listings on price, m², yield range, condition, distance-to-amenities, and zona-tensionada status. Use when the user asks 'compare X and Y' or 'which is the better deal.'

tools.name: neighborhood_brief
tools.description: Deterministic metrics for a city or neighborhood: median €/m², median yield range, transit score, hospital/university flags, zona-tensionada status, recent activity counts. Use when the user asks 'tell me about Bellvitge' or 'how does Reus look right now.' Does not invent prose — only structured metrics.

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood name. Optional; if omitted, returns city-level brief.

tools.name: agencies_in_city
tools.description: Verified real-estate agencies and gestorías in a Catalan city. Returns 3–5 results with name, address, phone, web, specialties, and last-verified date. Stale entries (>180 days unverified) are flagged. Use when the user asks 'who should I call about properties in Reus.'
